close_reason: connect_ws_with_limit and url_scheme both rewritten to use split_once + eq_ignore_ascii_case instead of to_ascii_lowercase. Zero-alloc scheme checks. Behaviour preserved (case-insensitive scheme matching per RFC 3986 §3.1). Also cleaned up a stray duplicate docstring from the JMAP-6lsm.23 rename.
description: src/ws/mod.rs:207 — `let ws_url_lc = ws_url.to_ascii_lowercase();` allocates a new String the size of the full URL just to run two `.starts_with("ws://")` / `"wss://"` checks against the prefix. Allocation grows with URL length and runs on every connect. Idiomatic alternative: `ws_url.split_once("://").is_some_and(|(s, _)| s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("ws") || s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("wss"))` — zero allocation, more direct, restricts the case-insensitivity to the scheme component (RFC 3986 §3.1 only says schemes are case-insensitive; path/query are not). Note: locked crate.
title: connect_ws lowercases entire URL just to check the scheme
